counts.tau_moduli_covered: all tau in the upper half-plane modulo elliptic-curve isomorphism

nonclaims: novelty of Lattes maps, torsion fixed-point descriptions, holomorphic Lefschetz, or Wold decomposition
a rational-prime or prime-power orbit correspondence
an arithmetic local factor, Euler factor, or root number
automorphy, a Hilbert--Polya operator, or Route-B authorization

source_lock.arithmetic_origin: elliptic torsion geometry only; no rational-prime or prime-power orbit correspondence is intrinsic
source_lock.determinant_convention: Artin--Mazur exponential only; ordinary Fredholm determinant of Koopman is unavailable
source_lock.family: all complex elliptic curves E_tau and every integer multiplication factor m>=2
source_lock.forbidden_data: prime tables, target zeros or divisors, arithmetic local factors, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya, and Route B
source_lock.map: f_{m,tau} o pi = pi o [m] on E_tau/{+/-1}=P^1
source_lock.normalization: unweighted fixed classes, separately resolved by multiplier channel
source_lock.precision: exact integer, rational, finite torsion, and symbolic formal-series arithmetic

theorem.channels: N_+=((a-1)^2-h)/2 at multiplier +a; N_-=((a+1)^2-h)/2 at multiplier -a; N_br=h at multiplier a^2
theorem.intersection: E_tau[gcd(m^n-1,m^n+1)] has h=1 for m^n even and h=4 for m^n odd
theorem.wold: U_m on L2(P1,pi_*Haar) is 1 direct_sum S^(aleph_0) on even Fourier modes
